title: Wavemother's Robe
summary: Protective clothing heals in water and casts both water spells.

fields.Defence: Clothing. Base AC 10 plus Dexterity and +1 AC. Resistance to Fire and Cold.
fields.Watery Rejuvenation: Start a turn standing in a Water surface to heal 1d4 HP. Turn-based mode can trigger this repeatedly outside combat.
fields.Create or Destroy Water: Level 4, Action, 30 ft range, 33 ft radius, once per Short Rest. This item grants both options through one recharge.
fields.Create Water: Extinguish flames, create Water and apply Wet for 3 turns. Wet makes most targets vulnerable to Cold and Lightning, removes existing resistance instead of adding vulnerability and grants Fire resistance. It can also reveal invisible creatures without a save.
fields.Destroy Water: Removes Wet from creatures and many water-like surfaces, including Water, Steam, Ice, ordinary Blood and Simple Toxin. The action does not remove Unstable Blood.
fields.Acquisition: Allandra Grey’s reward for completing Avenge the Drowned.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
